text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft eagerly begged her Trainer to 
let her watch the Takarazuka Kinen, where 
Sweep Tosho was running. She was overjoyed 
when given permission.

To triumph over the Umamusume on the 
Triple Crown route and overturn dull 
conventional wisdom. She was looking 
forward to watching such magical running.

That night, she invited Cesario to watch 
the Takarazuka Kinen, but was turned down. 
Cesario was preparing to challenge an 
American GⅠ.

Cesario shared that she held deep 
admiration for Line Craft, who was carving 
a new chapter in Tiara history. And that 
was precisely why she wanted to surpass 
her.

Believing that Cesario could forge a new 
future for the Tiara line, Rhein Kraft 
sent her her most heartfelt cheers.
